definitions.cycle: After previous unique fault, before current fault, same tool. Initial cycle begins at first sensor observation.
definitions.paper1_2000_shutter1_cycle_upper: At least 2000 raw 4-second observations with shutter=1 in the 5h before the event, after previous fault; only an upper bound for 2000-point windows because missing sensor values and source authors' exact screening are not checked.
definitions.paper3_3000_raw_5h_upper: At least 3000 raw observations within last 5h after previous fault; upper bound for paper Mmin=3000.
definitions.paper3_3000_tail_30m_gap_upper: As above, but truncate history after the latest internal >30-minute gap. Thirty minutes is our explicit sensitivity rule; paper does not state a numerical large-gap threshold.
definitions.paper3_3000_tail_and_recent_1h_upper: Tail criterion and latest sensor at most 1h before fault. One-hour recency is our application rule, not a paper rule.

limitations: These are event history availability estimates, not actual usable model sequences or performance. Exact paper count requires full sensor missingness, sample screening, onset labeling and fold-specific construction. No synthetic rows or model fits.
